extensions.name: Nimora
extensions.description: Live and upcoming sports, movie and TV catalogs, plus anime streams, running as a JavaScript bundle in the sandboxed QuickJS runtime.
extensions.author: nimbusfvck
releaseNotes: Fixed Savefilm NSFW source lookup when TMDB's title differs from Savefilm's article title by preserving the detail URL, supporting current headline markup, and resolving relative player tabs correctly.
Fixed Savefilm stream discovery: the provider now scans all Muvipro player tabs, decodes packed player configurations, and exposes direct HLS/MP4 sources with the required referer headers.

Fixed Indomax anime episode matching so year-suffixed search results do not select a same-title movie, and expanded NSFW source discovery to scan all player tabs including Peytonepre and IPlayerHLS fallback streams.
Follow Indomax's final redirect URL and probe the rotating `akses1`–`akses10` mirrors so the NSFW catalog survives mirror rotation.
Added an active Indomax catalog mirror fallback so the NSFW catalog still loads when `idmxl.ink` returns a blocked response before redirecting.
Changed Savefilm to an NSFW catalog-only provider: matched titles now use TMDB refs so the regular movie/TV stream providers handle playback, while Indomax keeps its own NSFW catalog and streams.
Refined the Savefilm health smoke to validate a current homepage movie through its active player tab and TurboVidHLS HLS playlist.
Fixed the Savefilm source health smoke to follow the active homepage movie and its `?player=N` tabs before validating the TurboVidHLS HLS playlist.
Added Savefilm Adult to the NSFW catalog and Savefilm movie/series source resolution through TurboVidHLS HLS streams, including paginated listings and series episode guides.
Fixed Dracin Shorts items being discarded by the app because episode metadata was missing its protocol-v2 parent reference.
Put Dracin Shorts ahead of TMDB in the Shorts feed so the first item is no longer a TMDB coming-soon title.
Hardened the KlikXXi Dracin release health smoke to try every player tab and select a supported Hexload stream when the first tab uses another server.
Added Dracin Shorts from KlikXXi: the latest portrait episodes are exposed as Shorts items and resolved through Muvipro AJAX to direct Hexload MP4 streams, with provider-specific health coverage.
Replaced the all-time popular movie and series shelves with Top Movies All Time and Top Series All Time, ranked by TMDB rating with a minimum of 1,000 votes.

Added paginated Popular Movies All Time and Popular Series All Time shelves, lowered the Korean and Indonesian shelf vote threshold to 5, and added movie collection metadata above recommendations in detail.
Switched TMDB detail recommendations to the dedicated recommendations endpoint, with similar titles retained only as a fallback.
Added partial source discovery: playback starts from the first non-empty provider result while the complete provider fan-out continues in the background for source switching and fallback.
Reduced FlyStream to one de-duplicated highest-quality source per title while keeping the source label generic so quality remains a player-level choice.

Added external subtitle lookup for AniList episodes: Nimora maps the selected AniList episode through FlyStream's identity route, then fetches Shegu's direct subtitle tracks for the mapped TMDB season and episode.

Fixed Sokuja returning no source for AniList episodes whose title is only `Shingeki no Kyojin`: a season-qualified Sokuja result such as `Shingeki no Kyojin Season 1` is now accepted even when AniList provides no episode air date.

Fixed Attack on Titan episodes returning no anime sources: Sokuja now accepts its season-qualified title (`Shingeki no Kyojin Season 1`), and FlyStream resolves AniList episode IDs through its identity mapping before requesting streams.

Removed MeteGol's fake per-stream quality claims: AlAngulo and FutbolLibre both printed the same "720p" on every single channel regardless of what actually played, so the label no longer states a quality the source never measured. Merged stream labels now also tag their origin site (Agenda18/AlAngulo/FutbolLibre/Deporflix), so identically named channels pulled from different sources under the same fixture (e.g. two "Disney+" entries) are no longer indistinguishable. Deporflix and FutbolLibre are disabled for now: Deporflix for its two-request chain and loose title matching, FutbolLibre for mostly relabeling AlAngulo's own channel pool (la18hd.su, streamtp-golden1.click) under a second near-identical name while covering fewer matches and streams.

Fixed episodes offering the skip-intro button twice: AniSkip carries several community submissions per episode, and overlapping ones were all kept, so skipping landed inside the next intro and offered the button again. Overlapping segments of the same kind now collapse to the earliest, and an outro sitting inside an opening is dropped rather than letting the player treat the first minutes as the end of the episode.

Reordered the movie and TV sources so VaPlayer and vidrock lead, FlyStream follows for the 4K ladder nothing else offers, and VidEasy trails after most of its entries failed to resolve; FlyStream's label no longer carries the ladder's top rung, which named a rendition the player does not open.
Added the protocol-v2 segments role backed by IntroDB for TMDB episodes and AniSkip for AniList anime episodes.
Added FlyStream as the first movie/TV source with fresh session-gated adaptive HLS resolution, and expanded source health checks to cover provider-specific endpoints and smoke flows.

Switched FotMob's popular league curation to the US market while retaining Indonesian match localization and the WIB calendar, preventing domestic Indonesian competitions from being promoted into Football.

Fixed Cricfy sources duplicating after refresh by keeping source IDs stable across token changes, and added the Deportivo A Coruña/Deportivo La Coruña football-name alias so MeteGol can match the fixture.
Removed redundant Al Angulo and Futbol Libre prefixes from stream labels and de-duplicated identical MeteGol stream URLs.

Expanded MeteGol football streams with Al Angulo, Futbol Libre, and Deporflix, preserving FotMob as the fixture catalog, per-source playback referers, and fresh token resolution; stream labels now show the source name without a redundant MeteGol prefix.

Added MeteGol's agenda18 football stream provider: it matches the agenda to FotMob fixtures, keeps the parsed schedule across launches when `host.storage` is available, and resolves fresh HLS playback URLs when a source is selected.

Kept Cricfy events and sources working while its API is slow or refusing: the event schedule is now requested with a longer timeout and kept between app launches, so a cold start serves the stored schedule straight away and refreshes it in the background instead of showing an empty Live row while the upstream stalls. Needs an app build that provides extension storage; on an older build nothing changes.
Kora now resolves a repeated source through a different edge each time, so retrying after a live stall takes another route instead of pinning to the one that just stalled.
Added paginated See more loading for TMDB Highlights backed by TMDB pages, including Korean and Indonesian shelves, Top Rated, Popular Today, and streaming-provider rows.
Added Popular Korean and Popular Indonesian Series & Movies shelves to TMDB Highlights, using popularity-ranked country filters with a reusable configuration for adding more countries later.
Removed finished football matches from the schedule takeout so completed fixtures no longer appear in `Today` or the upcoming Football shelf.
Fixed the women-only exclusion to detect women's competitions from the league name, including FotMob's `UEFA Women's Europa Cup`, even when club names do not carry a `(W)` suffix.
Fixed popular and international football curation to match league IDs only, preventing unrelated competitions with the same display name (such as Liviy Bereh vs Karpaty) from appearing.

Refined football fixture visibility using FotMob's `popular` and `international` league lists, removing noisy unlisted competitions while keeping the daily `/matches` feed, large club crests, and 433 league branding.

Switched football fixtures to FotMob's daily matches endpoint for schedule and live status, restoring matches missing from the TV guide such as Bournemouth vs Everton and Elversberg vs Leverkusen; all leagues are now shown, with large FotMob club crests and 433 league logos.

Fixed a live match staying marked as scheduled no matter how many times the app refreshed, e.g. Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest: FotMob spells some clubs differently in its schedule feed than by433 does in its live feed (e.g. "Nottm Forest" vs "Nottingham Forest"), so by433's live confirmation silently failed to match, and FotMob's own schedule fetch — which often carries no `isLive` flag at all — is cached for 15 minutes regardless of how often the app asks. Reconciles the known abbreviation variants.
Added competition branding to football event payloads: FotMob league colors and logos now reach the app so match banners can use the competition's visual identity.

Fixed Time Soccer highlights loading slowly and stalling on every quality switch: resolution (post, embed, playlist validation) spoofed a browser User-Agent throughout, but the resolved stream handed to the player carried no headers at all, so its own segment fetches fell back to the platform default UA — a mismatch a CDN that treats non-browser clients differently wouldn't show until real playback started. Playback now sends the same User-Agent resolution already used successfully.

Removed Football Highlights from the Shorts previews feed (added in 0.6.72): landscape recap footage doesn't fit Shorts' vertical format, and the clip a viewer would preview there is already the whole thing, not a lead-in to watch something bigger. The Football Highlights row on Home/Sport is unaffected.
Added a Football Highlights row to Home's Highlights shelf, sourced from Time Soccer alongside Trending Movie/TV and Popular Today.
Added Football Highlights to the Shorts previews feed: a highlight clip is already short-form, so its preview is the same Videa HLS stream full playback resolves, not a separate trailer lookup.

The `previews` catalog now checks every candidate for a resolvable YouTube trailer before including it, instead of leaving that to the app's own lazy per-item resolution — a title TMDB has no trailer for used to make it into the Shorts feed anyway, only to get skipped the instant the viewer swiped to it. The per-item trailer lookup this uses is cached, so resolving playback for the same title later doesn't repeat the fetch.
Added a Time Soccer TV football highlights catalog to Home and Sport, with Videa HLS playback and paginated See more loading so the catalog can continue beyond the initial batch.

Added a `previews` catalog to TMDB — Coming Soon interleaved two-to-one with released Trending Movie/TV, de-duplicated by ref — and a lightweight per-item trailer resolver (official Trailer, then official Teaser, then a non-official Trailer, then the newest video) that fetches only `/movie|tv/{id}/videos` per candidate instead of the full detail payload. This is the data source for the app's new Shorts feed; it does not change anything on Home.

Fixed Coming Soon still missing far-out tentpoles like Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday even after 0.6.67 started discovering them: the shelf re-sorted the combined movie/TV pool by nearest release date and cut it to 25, which buried a title releasing months out under an entire page of smaller titles releasing sooner. Coming Soon now ranks the merged pool by popularity, matching what each source query already used to decide who's in it.

Brought back Coming Soon, sourced properly this time: `/movie/upcoming` only covers the next month or two of theatrical releases, so a tentpole releasing later in the year (e.g. Dune: Part Three, Avengers: Doomsday) never appeared even though it's clearly upcoming. Movies and TV are now discovered by future release date and ranked by popularity instead, so the shelf leads with titles people actually anticipate rather than whichever small release happens to land soonest — while still dropping anything whose date turns out not to be genuinely in the future.

Removed the Coming Soon row: after filtering out titles TMDB misclassifies as upcoming (0.6.65), the region's genuinely future-dated catalog was thin enough on most days that the shelf wasn't worth a permanent spot on Home. Movie and TV items still carry their release date individually, so a title that isn't out yet still shows as upcoming wherever it appears (e.g. Trending) with the same Remind Me behavior.

Fixed Coming Soon showing titles that already released, such as Terminator and Avengers: Endgame: TMDB can list a title in `/movie/upcoming` (or `/discover/tv`) for reasons other than a genuine future release — e.g. a theatrical rerelease window — while the release date field we read and display still carries the original, long-past date. Coming Soon now re-checks that date itself and drops anything that isn't actually in the future, instead of trusting TMDB's own classification.

Added a release date to movie and TV catalog items and a new Coming Soon row (movies from `/movie/upcoming`, TV series from `/discover/tv` filtered to future air dates, both merged and ordered by how soon each one releases), so the app can flag titles that aren't out yet and let you get reminded before they are.

Fixed Home's Sport category still showing the Football shelf in editorial/league order (e.g. Real Madrid leading regardless of kickoff) even though the dedicated Football subcategory page ("See more") was already chronological — every football listing now sorts by kickoff, not just the one reached by drilling in.

Fixed live football matches disappearing from the Live category and Featured Hero whenever by433's live feed didn't happen to cover them: FotMob's own `isLive` flag is now trusted on its own within a plausible match window, instead of always requiring by433 confirmation.
Kept a match relevant for a day after kickoff instead of dropping it the moment it finished, so yesterday's results still show under their own "Yesterday" date section.

Treated England's EFL Cup (Carabao Cup / League Cup) as an important competition, like the existing Super Cup exception, since FotMob's account-localized "popular" league list leaves it out for most countries.

Fixed Cricfy events being memoized for the entire app session with no expiry: a fixture added to Cricfy's events list after the first fetch never got sources and never appeared under Live, no matter how many times the app was refreshed.
Added an alias for Athletic Club (Athletic Bilbao) so its official name no longer collapses to the bare, ambiguous "athletic" and fails to match Cricfy's own spelling of the team.

Grouped the Football section by kickoff day (Today, Tomorrow, then date) instead of by league, so a fixture kicking off soon no longer trails one still days away just because of league order in the feed.
Added a Popular Anime This Season row to Home, sourced from AniList's current season and sorted by popularity.
The anime grid no longer repeats the shelf name as a section heading.
Anime no longer appears twice on Home: TMDB's trending rows leave Japanese animation to the Trending Anime row.

Moved anime to AniList: the anime category, anime search when the Search screen is scoped to it, and Home's anime row, now called Trending Anime. AniList lists each cour as its own entry, numbered the way Sokuja and Indomax number them, so more episodes find a source. The separate Indomax Anime catalog is gone; Indomax still supplies streams.

Fixed Sokuja returning no sources for series older than the site, such as One Piece: episode matching no longer requires the site's upload date to equal the TMDB air date, and TMDB's arc-sized seasons are mapped onto Sokuja's absolute episode numbering.
Sokuja now discovers its current streaming domain at runtime from its landing hosts, so anime sources keep working when the mirror rotates instead of failing until the next release.
Ignored invalid Cricfy event and participant artwork URLs so malformed upstream images no longer break sports catalogs.
Filtered live football events to popular leagues, including by433 live matches matched by league name, while preserving friendly and Super Cup exceptions.
Kept provider-native subtitles on resolved sources and moved Shegu lookups to the explicit external-subtitles flow.
Split football schedule and live status: FotMob TV guide supplies the seven-day schedule, while by433's live feed drives the refreshed live section.
Guarded ImaxStreams HLS resolution against ad/image segments and invalid media, with candidate fallback to prevent audio-only or black-screen playback.
Added Cricfy `type: "embed"` stream resolution, recovering the DRM-free channel links that previously failed as "Empty link" because the resolver rejected them before consulting their `tokenApi`.

Waived the host allowlist with a bare `*`: Cricfy and the other providers receive their stream hosts from upstream at runtime, so pinning them broke playback whenever a host rotated without bounding what the native player already reaches.
Fixed Cricfy links whose header separator is percent-encoded, which sent the required `Referer` as part of the URL and made the origin reject playback with 403.
Fixed Cricfy source discovery by validating API responses and falling back to the default API when a configured endpoint fails.
Added Kora edge fallback for failed frame resolutions and added the current Cricfy playback hosts to the manifest permissions.
Fixed Indomax FirePlayer playback by forwarding the original page `Referer` and FirePlayer `Origin` headers to the signed HLS stream.
Fixed generic split-season episode matching across Sokuja and Indomax.
Added ImaxStreams `.com` player support and wildcard permission coverage for rotating player hosts.
Replaced numbered FirePlayer segment host entries with suffix-specific wildcard permissions.
Broadened the ImaxStreams TikTok CDN permission to cover its rotating segment subdomains.
Added the exact ImaxStreams TikTok CDN hosts required by Indomax HLS segments.
Fixed Indomax NSFW catalogs to expose every subcategory as a separate section.
Guarded Sokuja and Indomax episode resolution against season and episode mismatches.
Added the exact FirePlayer HLS segment hosts required by Indomax playback permissions.
Fixed Indomax FirePlayer HLS resolution using the current `securedLink` response and title search fallback without release years.
Added rich Indomax detail metadata, recommendations, trailers, and TV episode guides while preserving direct source URLs from catalog items.
Added Indomax search fallback plus separate NSFW and Anime catalogs with pagination and content-rating filtering.
Fixed Indomax playback by converting relative ImaxStreams HLS URLs to absolute URLs.
Fixed Indomax ImaxStreams playback resolution for current packed HLS responses.
Fixed Indomax source discovery to use the current ImaxStreams links from movie pages.
Added Indomax movie and episode streams, including ImaxStreams HLS extraction.
Use original provider names for all Nimora source labels instead of generated aliases.
Show detected resolution tokens from real provider source names beside aliases.
Show provider-reported source quality beside Sokuja aliases.
Fixed Sokuja split-cour anime episodes by matching provider episodes to their TMDB air dates.
Prioritized the Flux movie source so it appears first in default source selection.
Reverted Flux/MovieBox source priority so the default order follows configured provider ordering again.
Fixed MovieBox playlist format detection and forwarded the player-specific referer required by its streams.
Prioritized the Flux movie source so it appears first in default source selection.
Removed the SportzX provider and its unsupported source integration.
Restored FotMob as the football catalog source of truth and retained Super Cup fixtures across the popular-league filter.
Fixed UTC-to-Jakarta TV guide date handling and excluded Rugby events from Cricfy catalog entries.
Added SportzX as a live sports stream provider.
Fixed anime source matching for protocol-v2 episode items.
Added the current Sokuja storage host used by anime mirrors.
Added Sokuja anime mirrors as the Nova stream provider.
Added a Top Anime shelf to the Home catalog using Crunchyroll availability.
Limited Popular Today to paid streaming subscriptions from TMDB.
Added a Popular Today shelf with streaming titles from TMDB.
Added similar movie and series recommendations to detail metadata.
Added YouTube preview thumbnails to Shegu trailer metadata when TMDB provides one.
Added optional Shegu preview streams for autoplay in the detail header.
Added official TMDB trailers to movie and series detail metadata.
Excluded Baseball events from the sports catalog and featured feed.
Prioritized fixtures involving the configured top football clubs while preserving FotMob's order for the rest of the schedule.
Added TMDB title artwork to featured movie and series items, with text fallback when no logo is available.
Validate Cricfy playback manifests before handing them to the native player, filtering upstream 4xx/5xx and invalid HLS/DASH responses.
Added the exact Cricfy playback hosts required by the manifest preflight guard.
Added richer movie and series details, including release, language, status, and availability facts.
Renamed content certification facts for clarity.
